description: Search Meta targeting values for ads_create, a saved build spec, or set_targeting in ads_edit_preview. Use type=city to find targeting.cities[].key values, type=zip to find targeting.zips[].key values, or type=detailed for {id,name,type} entries. Builds use targeting.detailedTargetingGroups; edits use add/remove with the returned type and {id}. IDs must never be guessed; use this tool to discover them.

query.description: City name, zip/postal code, or detailed-targeting keyword to search.

type.description: Use city to find targeting.cities[].key values, zip to find targeting.zips[].key values, or detailed to find detailedTargetingGroups selections.

name: ads_search_targeting
title: Search Targeting Options
